leaf="">发出去以后总有人问我：</span><span style="font-style: italic;text-decoration: underline 2px rgb(167, 243, 208);text-underline-offset: 3px;"><span leaf="">豆包工作跟其他 Agent 到底有什么不一样？</span></span></p></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><section style="margin: 12px 0px;text-align: center;line-height: 0;border-radius: 8px;overflow: hidden;"><section nodeleaf=""><img data-src="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/sz_mmbiz_png/iaZPxh36Uvux7CibIhiamsSLpAb2ETeq6c9aw39gQTDogCpriafDiaAkuv9ia5EPhsu0IeSx1L5nVzMttb4KdicesCOeZ2TBqpia0b05NICpKQUy99M/640?wx_fmt=png&amp;from=appmsg" data-aistatus="1"  /></section></section></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">我觉得最大的区别就是飞书。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">豆包工作是字节 8 月 25 号发布的生产力 Agent，直接跑在飞书生态上面，多维表格、知识库、文档、定时任务全是原生打通的。别的 Agent 要么只能聊天，要么能操作但没有自己的数据底座。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">豆包工作有，</span><span style="background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgb(253, 230, 138) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 100%);padding: 0px 4px;border-radius: 2px;font-weight: 700;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);"><span leaf="">飞书就是它的底座</span></span><span leaf="">。PC 端、手机遥控、云电脑三个入口都能用。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">我自己写蓝皮书的过程中就很明显感觉到这一点。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">一个人要管商单排期、记账、回款跟进、素材整理、选题规划，一堆事同时转。CEO 是我，财务是我，行政是我，</span><span style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgb(254, 202, 202);"><span leaf="">干活的还是我</span></span><span leaf="">。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">所以我用豆包工作给自己真开了一家公司——</span><span style="font-weight: 800;color: rgb(5, 150, 105);"><span leaf="">「摸鱼有限公司」</span></span><span leaf="">。战略部管方向，行政部管事，财务部管钱，智库管经验，四个部门全配齐。</span></p></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><section style="margin: 12px 0px;text-align: center;line-height: 0;border-radius: 8px;overflow: hidden;"><section nodeleaf=""><img data-src="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_png/iaZPxh36UvuzFMlR4n3YtfdS38Ts91PEAGJe6lVqQhtPoP98TRlD950mfeQ7vcdXIDMbf7SSVHTSMrm8qPyCQpL4C8reTY7hY7D67ywTOK9w/640?wx_fmt=png&amp;from=appmsg" class="rich_pages /></section></section></section><section style="margin-top: 48px;margin-bottom: 24px;padding: 0px 12px;"><section style="display: flex;align-items: center;gap: 12px;white-space: nowrap;"><p style="margin: 0px;font-size: 60px;font-weight: 900;font-style: italic;color: rgb(229, 231, 235);line-height: 0.9;letter-spacing: -4px;"><span leaf="">01</span></p><section><p style="margin: 0px;font-size: 18px;font-weight: 900;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.25;"><span leaf="">开张</span></p><p style="margin: 4px 0px 0px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 9px;font-weight: 700;color: rgb(156, 163, 175);line-height: 1;letter-spacing: 1.5px;"><span leaf="">COMPANY OS / CONSTITUTION</span></p></section></section></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">怎么让这四个部门跑起来？</span><span style="background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgb(253, 230, 138) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 100%);padding: 0px 4px;border-radius: 2px;font-weight: 600;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);"><span leaf="">先立一份「制度」</span></span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">制度其实就是一段 Prompt，把公司架构、飞书表格结构、行为规则和日常暗号全写死在里面。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">只要写清楚，它就知道自己是谁、管什么、怎么干，</span><span style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgb(167, 243, 208);font-weight: 600;"><span leaf="">不用每次重新解释</span></span><span leaf="">。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);"><span leaf="">直接抄：</span></span></p></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><section style="margin: 12px 0px 18px;border: 1px solid rgb(229, 231, 235);border-radius: 8px;overflow: hidden;background: rgb(249, 250, 251);"><section style="display: flex;align-items: center;justify-content: space-between;padding: 10px 12px;border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(229, 231, 235);background: rgb(243, 244, 246);"><span style="font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 10px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);letter-spacing: 1px;"><span leaf="">摸鱼有限公司“制度”</span></span><span style="font-size: 10px;color: rgb(156, 163, 175);"><span leaf="">上下滑动查看 ↕</span></span></section><section style="height: 320px;overflow-y: auto;padding: 14px 14px 18px;box-sizing: border-box;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 12px;line-height: 1.8;color: rgb(55, 65, 81);"><span leaf="">你是「摸鱼有限公司」的管家。我是这家公司唯一的 CEO。公司经营我的人生：方向、事、钱、经验。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 8px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;line-height: 1.8;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);"><span leaf="">【公司架构】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 12px;line-height: 1.8;color: rgb(55, 65, 81);"><span leaf="">战略部：管方向。把我的心愿拆成 OKR，O 是愿景，KR 必须可测量。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">行政部：管事。待办、排期、合同杂务、提醒。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">财务部：管钱。记账、商单回款跟进。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">智库：管经验。收录文章和素材，写稿时调出来参考。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 8px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;line-height: 1.8;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);"><span leaf="">【生产资料】（都已授权你访问）</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 12px;line-height: 1.8;color: rgb(55, 65, 81);"><span leaf="">1. 多维表格「OKR 表」：领域、O、KR、目标值、当前值、截止日期。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">2. 多维表格「任务表」：任务名、关联KR、类型、截止日期、状态（待办/进行中/完成）。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">3. 多维表格「账本」：日期、金额、商户、分类、备注。分类只能选：餐饮/交通/办公采购/生活/其他。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">4. 多维表格「商单台账」：合作昵称、询单渠道、品牌、报价、预计发布日期、回款截止日期、回款状态（未到期/待回款/已回款）、内容状态（待Brief/待大纲/待初稿/待审核/待发布/已发布）。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">5. 飞书知识库「智库」：我过去发布的文章和收集的素材。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 8px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;line-height: 1.8;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);"><span leaf="">【铁律】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 12px;line-height: 1.8;color: rgb(55, 65, 81);"><span leaf="">1. 事实规则：数字、金额、日期以表格和截图为准。没有说「没有」，识别不了说「识别不了」。不许编不许估。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">2. 验证规则：每次写入后回读字段值给我确认。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">3. 枚举规则：分类、状态只能从上面选，不许自造。拿不准归「其他」并备注。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">4. 汇报规则：先数字再判断，每条理由不超一句。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">5. 挂钩规则：新任务能挂 KR 就必须挂。挂不上问我「这事归哪个方向」。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 8px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;line-height: 1.8;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);"><span leaf="">【暗号】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 12px;line-height: 1.8;color: rgb(55, 65, 81);"><span leaf="">「定方向」+ 心愿 → 拆 OKR，写表，回读。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">「记一笔」+ 截图 → 提取金额商户，按枚举分类，写账本，回读。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">「早请示」→ 今日到期 + 本周商单 + 卡住 3 天的，三档输出。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">「巡检」→ 7 天内到期未回款商单，列清单带天数。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">「收一下」+ 链接 → 入库智库，建资料卡。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">「问智库」+ 问题 → 用旧文回答，附标题当证据。</span><span leaf=""><br  /></span><span leaf="">「开周会」→ 周报存飞书文档发我。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 12px;line-height: 1.8;color: rgb(55, 65, 81);"><span leaf="">不确定问我，办不到说不行。先回我：架构、生产资料、铁律、暗号，认到了哪些。</span></p></section></section></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><section style="margin: 12px 0px;text-align: center;line-height: 0;border-radius: 8px;overflow: hidden;"><section nodeleaf=""><img data-src="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/sz_mmbiz_png/iaZPxh36UvuyDjicnsxcohhAc3kopBEGdcXhAIko4HNqUqHZYaM09af8Ce8nAx0wuuFicu51vqlBuvEb2A6cBwLn0CtD0xeLibL4SAnNH3nGLhQ/640?wx_fmt=png&amp;from=appmsg" data-aistatus="1"  /></section></section></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><section style="margin: 14px 0px 20px;padding-top: 10px;border-top: 2px solid rgb(17, 24, 39);"><section
